reply.text:
I can help with that. Let me look at what you've actually been doing lately, so I'm not guessing. Nothing is logged for the last six weeks, and there's no active program on your account. So I can't see a slump in your numbers, and I'm not going to invent one.

If you've been away from training, that's common, and it's not a verdict on you. Good to have you back, and we start from today. Tell me what's going on: is it that you've lost the drive to go, that you don't know what to do when you get there, or that life has simply swallowed the time? Each has a different fix, and once I know which, we can pick one small session you can actually do this week.
